title.english: The Road You Can Ask For

pairs.target: xìn xiě dào dìsānzhāng , tǎ wéi cái búzài jiào chí ān " dāngnián de háizi ".
pairs.english: Only on his third sheet did Tavi stop calling Chian “the child from back then.”
pairs.hanzi: 信写到第三张，塔维才不再叫迟安“当年的孩子”。

pairs.target: tā jiāng qián liǎngzhāng shōu qǐlái , liú zhe yìfēng bùmǎn yíyè de : zìjǐ cóng wū yà nàlǐ dú dào jiù jiēshōu bó , xiǎng dǎtīng céng hùsòng chí ān xiàshān de fú lán .
pairs.english: He put the first two sheets away, keeping a letter shorter than a page: he had read the old receiving register through Wuya and wanted to ask about Fulan, who had once escorted Chian down the mountain.
pairs.hanzi: 他将前两张收起来，留着一封不满一页的：自己从乌娅那里读到旧接收簿，想打听曾护送迟安下山的芙兰。

pairs.target: ruò chí ān yuànyì huíxiǎng , tā xiǎng zhīdào , nàwèi nǚrén bǎ rén sòngdào yǐhòu , yǒuméiyǒu shuō guò háiyào qù nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: If Chian was willing to remember, he wanted to know whether, after bringing them there, the woman had said where she would go next.
pairs.hanzi: 若迟安愿意回想，他想知道，那位女人把人送到以后，有没有说过还要去哪里。

pairs.target: tā méi jiāng zìjǐ cāi guò de guānxì xiějìnqù , zhī shuō zìjǐ yě zài xúnzhǎo hěnxiǎo de shíhòu rènshi de rén .
pairs.english: He left out the relationship he had guessed at, saying only that he too was looking for people he had known when very small.
pairs.hanzi: 他没将自己猜过的关系写进去，只说自己也在寻找很小的时候认识的人。

pairs.target: xìn de mòwěi liú le bái jiē xuégōng de zhuǎn xìn dìzhǐ , qǐng xǔ lián fāngbiàn shí tì tā zhuǎnjiāo , búbì cuī wèn .
pairs.english: At the end he left a forwarding address at the White Steps academy, asking Xu Lian to pass it on when convenient, without chasing a reply.
pairs.hanzi: 信的末尾留了白阶学宫的转信地址，请许莲方便时替他转交，不必催问。

pairs.target: tā lìng gěi sè lā xiě le yìfēng , jiāng xīn zhīdào de míngzì , liùzhōu qián de xìn hé sōng dī de dìzhǐ dōu chāo gěi tā , xiě dào zuìhòu tiān le yíjù : wǒ hái zài fēng zhàn , hǎohǎo shàngbān .
pairs.english: He wrote another to Sela, copying out the newly learned names, the letter from six weeks ago, and the Songdi address. At the end he added a line: I'm still at Wind Trestle, going to work as I should.
pairs.hanzi: 他另给瑟拉写了一封，将新知道的名字、六周前的信和松堤的地址都抄给她，写到最后添了一句：我还在风栈，好好上班。

pairs.target: zǎochén bǎ qián hé liǎngfēngxìn jiāodào miànbāo pù lóuxià shí , tā yídù xiǎng zài dǎkāi kànyíbiàn .
pairs.english: When he handed over the money and two letters downstairs in the bakery that morning, he briefly wanted to open them and read them again.
pairs.hanzi: 早晨把钱和两封信交到面包铺楼下时，他一度想再打开看一遍。

pairs.target: shōuxìn de nǚrén yǐjīng jiāng yóudài kǒu de shéngzi rào le liǎngquān , wèn tā shìfǒu shǎo fàng le dōngxī . tǎ wéi yáotóu . tā mǎi le yígè rè bǐng , zǒu dào shōuhuò chù cái xiǎngqǐ dìyīkǒu yě méi yǎo .
pairs.english: The woman collecting letters had already wound the mailbag cord twice and asked whether he had left anything out. Tavi shook his head. He bought a hot flatbread and only at the receiving office remembered he hadn't taken even the first bite.
pairs.hanzi:
收信的女人已经将邮袋口的绳子绕了两圈，问他是否少放了东西。
塔维摇头。他买了一个热饼，走到收货处才想起第一口也没咬。

pairs.target: zhètiān de liáng jià huó zuò wán dé zǎo . ruǎn héng zuòzài chuāng biān kàn tā bǔ hǎo de tái jǐng wǎngfǎn tú , zhǐjiān tíng zài yíkuài huà dé géwài dà de shítou shàng .
pairs.english: The rack measurements were finished early that day. Ruan Heng sat by the window studying his completed round-trip map to Moss Well, a fingertip resting on a stone drawn unusually large.
pairs.hanzi: 这天的量架活做完得早。阮衡坐在窗边看他补好的苔井往返图，指尖停在一块画得格外大的石头上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiěshì , nà kuài bèifēng shí qíngtiān kě xiē , yǔ hòu shí miàn dǎhuá , shì xià róng shuō de ; zìjǐ méiyǒu zài yǔtiān zǒuguò .
pairs.english: Tavi explained: the sheltered stone was a rest stop in fine weather but slippery after rain, according to Xiarong; he hadn't walked there in wet weather himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维解释，那块背风石晴天可歇，雨后石面打滑，是夏绒说的；自己没有在雨天走过。

pairs.target: zài wǎng xià de shuǐgōu , tā zài tú shàng liú le kōng , bù ná yuǎnchù wàngjiàn de yìdiǎn liàngguāng dàngzuò guò shuǐ de lù .
pairs.english: For the ditch farther down he left a blank on the map, rather than treating a distant glint as a way across the water.
pairs.hanzi: 再往下的水沟，他在图上留了空，不拿远处望见的一点亮光当作过水的路。

pairs.target: " zhèér de zì liú dà xiē . " ruǎn héng jiāng zhǐ zhuǎn huílái , " tā nádào shǒu , xīngxǔ zhèngzài chēshàng . "
pairs.english: “Make the writing larger here.” Ruan Heng turned the paper back. “She might be on a cart when she gets it.”
pairs.hanzi: “这儿的字留大些。”阮衡将纸转回来，“她拿到手，兴许正在车上。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàozhuó zhòngxiě , jiāng nài lěi de yuán xìn shōu hǎo , gěi tā de huíxìn jiá shàng zhè zhāng tú .
pairs.english: Tavi rewrote it accordingly, put Nerai's original letter away, and enclosed the map with his reply to her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维照着重写，将奈蕾的原信收好，给她的回信夹上这张图。

pairs.target: tā xiě zìjǐ yuànyì jìnyíbù wèn nà fèn suíxíng huàtú de huó , rìqī hé qùchù dé xiān sòng ruǎn héng yǔ xuégōng kàn , hái méi dìngxià néng bunéng qù .
pairs.english: He wrote that he wanted to ask further about the accompanying sketch work, but dates and destinations must first go to Ruan Heng and the academy for review; whether he could go was still undecided.
pairs.hanzi: 他写自己愿意进一步问那份随行画图的活，日期和去处得先送阮衡与学宫看，还没定下能不能去。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng yǐ kànguò zhè fēng huíxìn , méiyǒu tì tā tiān shàng yígè shuǎngkuài de yīngyǔn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng had read the reply, without adding a ready yes on his behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡已看过这封回信，没有替他添上一个爽快的应允。

pairs.target: wǔhòu yóuchē fā zǒu qián , tǎ wéi bǎ zhè yìfēng yě fùqián jìchū . dàizǐ tái shàngchēshí , tā zài ménbiān zhàn le piànkè , juéde jīntiān zuò de shì bùshǎo , shǒulǐ què kōng dé hěn .
pairs.english: Before the afternoon mail cart departed, Tavi paid to send this letter too. As the bag was lifted aboard he stood by the door a moment, feeling he'd done quite a lot today, yet his hands were very empty.
pairs.hanzi: 午后邮车发走前，塔维把这一封也付钱寄出。袋子抬上车时，他在门边站了片刻，觉得今天做的事不少，手里却空得很。

pairs.target: yīwén láishí huàn le jiàn méi kòu jiānzhāng de wàiyī , kùjiǎo réng zhān zhe huī .
pairs.english: When Iven came he had changed into a coat without his shoulder insignia fastened on, though his trouser hems were still dusty.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文来时换了件没扣肩章的外衣，裤脚仍沾着灰。

pairs.target: tāmen yán miànbāo pù hòumiàn de gōnglù wǎngběizǒu , dào le tōngxiàng shíqiáo de chàkǒu , zhuǎn shàng réng yǒu zhùhù wǎnglái de duǎn pō .
pairs.english: They walked north along the road behind the bakery, then at the junction toward the stone bridge turned onto a short slope still used by local residents.
pairs.hanzi: 他们沿面包铺后面的公路往北走，到了通向石桥的岔口，转上仍有住户往来的短坡。

pairs.target: yǔ hòu de qiǎngōu yǐjīng tuì le shuǐ , ní shàng liú zhe jī zhuǎyìn , shuíjiā jiāng xǐ guò de bèi miàn pù zài ǎiqiáng shàng , shài dé bàn gān de bù biān yìzhí pāi tǎ wéi de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: The shallow ditches had drained after the rain, chicken tracks marked the mud, and someone had spread a washed quilt cover over a low wall. Its half-dried edge kept slapping Tavi's sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 雨后的浅沟已经退了水，泥上留着鸡爪印，谁家将洗过的被面铺在矮墙上，晒得半干的布边一直拍塔维的袖子。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎoshíhòu xiǎng dāng huà dìtú de . " yīwén shuō , " búshì xiànzài zhèzhǒng , nǎyìtiáo lù shōu shénme fèi . wǒ xiǎng huà yǒu hǎi de nàzhǒng . zuìhǎo hǎibiān hái méi xiě míngzì . "
pairs.english: “When I was little I wanted to draw maps,” Iven said. “Not this sort, with what tolls are charged on which road. I wanted the kind with a sea. Preferably with no names along its shore yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “我小时候想当画地图的。”伊文说，“不是现在这种，哪一条路收什么费。我想画有海的那种。最好海边还没写名字。”

pairs.target: " huà wán ne ? " " yìnchūlái , mài hěnduō qián . nǐ shìbushì yǐwéi wǒ jiēxiàlái yàoshuō qù màoxiǎn ? "
pairs.english: “And when you've drawn it?” “Print it. Sell it for lots of money. Did you think I was going to say I'd go adventuring next?”
pairs.hanzi:
“画完呢？”
“印出来，卖很多钱。你是不是以为我接下来要说去冒险？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le . " nǐ kěyǐ zài huà yìsōuchuán . " " duì . chuán yě màiqián . "
pairs.english: Tavi laughed. “You could draw a ship too.” “Yes. Sell the ship too.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维笑了。“你可以再画一艘船。”
“对。船也卖钱。”

pairs.target: pōdǐng yǒu gè xiánzhe de niǎn gǔchǎng , yuǎnchù de huòxiāng zhèng cóng gǔkǒu huǎnhuǎn yí guò .
pairs.english: An idle threshing ground stood at the top of the slope. In the distance a cargo carriage was moving slowly past the valley mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 坡顶有个闲着的碾谷场，远处的货厢正从谷口缓缓移过。

pairs.target: liǎng rén zuò shàng shài rè de shí yán , tǎ wéi zhè cái shuō xìn yǐjīng jì le . tā méiyǒu zhòng jiǎng xìn lǐ dehuà , yīwén yě méi wèn tā jǐshí dòngshēn , zhī wèn ruò chí ān xiě lái , tā huì buhuì hàipà chāi .
pairs.english: They sat on the sun-warmed stone edging, and only then did Tavi say he'd sent the letter. He didn't repeat its contents, and Iven didn't ask when he was leaving, only whether he'd be afraid to open a letter if Chian wrote.
pairs.hanzi: 两人坐上晒热的石沿，塔维这才说信已经寄了。他没有重讲信里的话，伊文也没问他几时动身，只问若迟安写来，他会不会害怕拆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō búhuì , zuìhòu diǎn le tóu .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to say no, but finally nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想说不会，最后点了头。

pairs.target: " nà jiù děng wǒ huílái zài chāi . " yīwén shuōwán yòu yáotóu , " bùxíng . wǒ bù zhīdào yào gēn shī nán qù jǐzhàn . nǐ zhēn děng le , wǒ zài lùshang huì hěn tǎoyàn zìjǐ . "
pairs.english: “Then wait until I come back to open it.” Iven shook his head as soon as he said it. “No. I don't know how many stations I'll go to with Shinan. If you really waited I'd hate myself on the road.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就等我回来再拆。”伊文说完又摇头，“不行。我不知道要跟施南去几站。你真等了，我在路上会很讨厌自己。”

pairs.target: " wǒ chāi wán xiěxìn gàosù nǐ . " yīwén dītóu bōkāi shífèng lǐ de yìgēn cǎo . " hǎo de yě gàosù wǒ . nǐ bié zǒng juéde wǒ máng , shìqíng yí bùnán le , jiù méi bìyào xiě . "
pairs.english: “I'll write and tell you after I've opened it.” Iven lowered his head and pushed aside a blade of grass in a stone crack. “Tell me the good things too. Don't always think I'm busy and there's no need to write once things aren't difficult.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我拆完写信告诉你。”
伊文低头拨开石缝里的一根草。“好的也告诉我。你别总觉得我忙，事情一不难了，就没必要写。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jì qǐ zìjǐ yǒu yízhèn zhī zài yùdào nántí shí zhǎo tā , píngrì de xiǎoshì wǎngwǎng liú dào xiǎngbùqǐlái .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered a time when he'd only sought him out with problems, often putting everyday trifles off until he'd forgotten them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维记起自己有一阵只在遇到难题时找他，平日的小事往往留到想不起来。

pairs.target: cǐkè tā kànjiàn yīwén xié cè yǒu yìxiǎokuài xīn bǔ de pí , bǐ yuánlái de yánsè qiǎn , hūrán xiǎng wèn tā huìguǎn de chuáng shìbushì hái xián duǎn , yòu juéde zìjǐ yǐjīng zhīdào dáàn .
pairs.english: Now he noticed a small patch of new leather on Iven's shoe, paler than the original, and suddenly wanted to ask if the lodge bed still felt too short, then felt he already knew the answer.
pairs.hanzi: 此刻他看见伊文鞋侧有一小块新补的皮，比原来的颜色浅，忽然想问他会馆的床是不是还嫌短，又觉得自己已经知道答案。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zǎochén mǎi de bǐng bāikāi . bǐng lěng le , yóu shènjìn bāo zhǐ , yīwén kàn le yìyǎn , wèn tā shìbushì děngdào zìjǐ lái cái shědechī .
pairs.english: He broke apart the flatbread he'd bought that morning. It was cold, oil soaking into its wrapping. Iven glanced at it and asked whether he'd only brought himself to eat once Iven arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 他将早晨买的饼掰开。饼冷了，油渗进包纸，伊文看了一眼，问他是不是等到自己来才舍得吃。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō chàbùduō , méi shuō shì yílù wàng le , yīwén jiēguò qù , yǎo dé hěn yònglì .
pairs.english: Tavi said more or less, not mentioning he'd forgotten it the whole way. Iven took it and bit hard.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说差不多，没说是一路忘了，伊文接过去，咬得很用力。

pairs.target: mùsè luòxiàlái zhīqián , tāmen zǒu huí jiēshàng . yīwén dé huí huìguǎn shōushí cìrì de gōngshì , tǎ wéi zài miànbāo pù ménqián tóng tā fēnkāi ,
pairs.english: They walked back to the street before dusk fell. Iven had to return to the lodge to prepare for the next day's work. Tavi parted from him outside the bakery,
pairs.hanzi: 暮色落下来之前，他们走回街上。伊文得回会馆收拾次日的公事，塔维在面包铺门前同他分开，

pairs.target: kànzhe tā ràoguò yíliàng tíng dé wāixié de chē , yòu tuìhuílái , shēnshǒu bān zhèng le chàdiǎn gōuzhù yīxiù de mùgān . yuǎnchù yǒurén hǎn kāifàn , jiēshàng hǎojǐ shànmén yìtóng kāi le .
pairs.english: watching him go round a crookedly parked cart, then step back and reach out to straighten the wooden pole that had nearly snagged his sleeve. Someone called dinner in the distance, and several doors on the street opened together.
pairs.hanzi: 看着他绕过一辆停得歪斜的车，又退回来，伸手扳正了差点勾住衣袖的木杆。远处有人喊开饭，街上好几扇门一同开了。
